nom: celimax The Real Noni Energy Ampoule Hydrating Glow Serum

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive skin, including rosacea and allergy-prone skin, report the serum calms and reduces redness without stinging or triggering breakouts, though one reviewer without normally sensitive skin reports a minty tingling that irritated a dry spot for weeks.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including very dry winter skin, report strong hydration and plumping, with one calling it a holy-grail step she never skips; one reviewer found it not quite enough alone for her dry winter skin and layered it under moisturizer.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances oilier areas without leaving drier areas tight, evens out skin tone, and works well as part of a routine.
segments.oily: One reviewer describes her sensitive, acne-prone and oily skin as compatible with the serum, reporting no breakouts and a subtle glow.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s report compliments on their skin's glow and describe it as nurturing for skin that needs more care with age.

concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, including many with rosacea or reactive skin, report visibly reduced redness within days to a couple of weeks of regular use, often alongside a calmer, more even complexion.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers overwhelmingly report strong, lightweight hydration and plumping, including several who reach for it specifically when their skin feels dry, dehydrated or irritated from other treatments like retinol.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, report no new breakouts and some see fewer breakouts over weeks of use; one reviewer reports it is not fungal-acne safe and triggers her fungal acne when paired with other deep-moisturizing products.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the serum with repairing or supporting their skin barrier, including one who paired it with an increased retinoid routine as a buffer.
concerns.aging: A few reviewers report their fine lines look softer or less visible after a couple of weeks of use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports slightly less oil production on her T-zone since adding the serum to her routine.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel that absorbs without stickiness
Can cause a minty or tingling sensation for some
Light, pleasant fragrance (rose or herbal notes)

extraits.texte: I received this product as a gift. I've used other products with noni as the hero ingredient and I'm excited to see it get more attention. I don't normally have sensitive skin but I have been using more actives lately so I wonder if that might have had an impact. The serum felt really hydrating but the minty feeling irritated my skin. I'm still working on healing the dry spot a month later. I think I'll give it another try when I use less actives.

I like keeping this ampoule on rotation! It hydrates and soothes my skin but it is not fungal acne safe. If I use this product with other deep moisturizing products it triggers my fungal acne. I use this with a gel cream and it reduces my redness and gives me glass skin! I can see this profuct being great for a lot of people!

I have really dry skin so this is a holy grail product for me. I will NEVER skip this part in my routine and even use it to help calm and hydrate my skin when it's extra dry. Definitely gives a glow and is perfect for helping out texture - already almost done with my second one!

I have super sensitive,combination skin with redness After using this serum it soothes my skin ,calm and reduced my redness and i am using this serum am/pm sometime with or without moisturizer . 100 % recommended

extraits.titre: Gentle and Effective Relief for skin
extraits.texte: I love this product. It does exactly what it claims. It soothes and hydrates skin and calms redness. While using this I experienced a more even skin tone. The formula didn't cause a breakout. But left my skin hydrated and nourished. Great for combination skin.

I've been using the Celimax Noni Ampoule for about 8 days now, and while it's obviously too early to see any dramatic changes, I have noticed a difference in my skin barrier. My skin feels calmer, more comfortable, and less reactive overall. The texture is lightweight but nourishing, and it layers really well without feeling sticky or heavy. I've been focusing on barrier support lately, and this ampoule fits perfectly into that routine — my skin just feels more balanced and supported, especially after cleansing. No breakouts, no irritation, just a subtle improvement in how resilient my skin feels. It's definitely one of those products that works quietly in the background, and I'm excited to keep using it long-term to see more results.

I've been using the the Celimax Noni Ampoule for almost two weeks now and it's definitely senstive, acne-prone, oily skin friendly. I have not experienced any breakouts and it leaves a fresh and subtle glow after applied. I've used it in my nighttime skin routine and i like how lightweight it feels, it doesnt feel sticky and leaves my skin naturally radiant. The constistency is a bit on the liquidy side, almost more of a thinner viscosity than i'm used to but i only have to use two small pumps for my whole face.
